items.title: BROADCAST MISINFORMATION
items.placementTarget: Back of each player reference card
items.text:
BROADCAST MISINFORMATION
At a satellite tower, move a Hollow Men figure to a location adjacent to its current location. Your city's color must match the figure's current city.

mechanics.effect: Move a Hollow Men figure to a location adjacent to its current location.
restrictions: You must be at a satellite tower
The destination is adjacent to the figure's current location
Your city's color must match the figure's current city

items.title: Reference card placement
items.text: Place this sticker on the back of each player reference card.

mechanics.effect: Place the action sticker on the back of each player reference card.

summary: Broadcast Misinformation action overlay and the instruction to put it on the back of each player reference card. The door numeral is printed rotated 90° counter-clockwise. The placement strip is byte-identical to doors 38 and 39.
